def render(parts):
    chunks = []
    total = 0
    for part in parts:
        body = encode_part(part)
        chunks.append(body)
        total += len(body)
    buffer = bytearray(total + 256)
    offset = 0
    for i, body in enumerate(chunks):
        buffer[offset : offset + len(body)] = body
        offset += len(body)
        chunks[i] = b""
    chunks.clear()
    return bytes(buffer[:offset])
